_about: Written by tools/import_zone_kit.gd from data/source/dna_kit.csv and the art in G:/My Drive/Card Game Art/Approved_ZoneKits/DNA: one entry per kit id with its lock, family (group / slot), prepared size, pivot (0..1 of the trimmed image), tile size in metres at 400 px/m, sheet parts. EnvKit reads it: every id here resolves like an Environment Kit id (assets/art/zone_kits/dna/<ID>.webp). Hand-added keys (height, width, tile, placeholder, slot) survive a re-import; entries not on the sheet (aliases) are kept.

DNA-BD-TOWERS.desc: A distant skyline of gray office towers with faint green-lit windows and filing-cabinet spires, hazy.

DNA-DEC-COFFEE.desc: Brown coffee cup rings seen from above, soft edges.

DNA-DEC-FOOT.desc: Faint worn footprints in a line, seen from above, soft fading edges.

DNA-HERO-ENDLESS-QUEUE.desc: A long winding line of patient ghost and skeleton citizens between brass queue posts and red rope, snaking into the distance toward a single tiny service window.

DNA-HERO-FILING-TOWER.desc: A teetering tower of stacked gray filing cabinets (about 22 m tall), drawers half open with papers fluttering, a ladder winding up it.

DNA-HERO-FINAL-APPROVALS.desc: The main-dungeon goal: an enormous, imposing gray civic hall (about 32 m wide, towering) with tall columns, a giant clock frozen at 4:59, a colossal rubber-stamp relief over the doors, endless stairs, and green-lit windows. Must read from across the zone as THE place to go.
DNA-HERO-FINAL-APPROVALS.use: Main dungeon goal, visible from the whole zone
